title: - Inferno - (3KoTH)

replies.author: kon333
replies.body: Looks alright, there isn't much texture in the floor and walls. The netherack is rather overwhelming. The walls are also very blocky and straight. Other than that it lookd good!
replies.body_tagged: Looks alright, there isn't much texture in the floor and walls. The netherack is rather overwhelming. The walls are also very blocky and straight. Other than that it lookd good!

replies.author: cincip
replies.body: Lava would still be annoying even with fire resistance as someone could be knocked into the lava and would have to swim through it. My advice, put barriers to prevent people from going into lava.
replies.body_tagged: Lava would still be annoying even with fire resistance as someone could be knocked into the lava and would have to swim through it. My advice, put barriers to prevent people from going into lava.

replies.author: Myv
replies.body: Adding lava to the floor was our original intention as it makes it more interesting.
replies.body_tagged: Adding lava to the floor was our original intention as it makes it more interesting.

replies.author: cellish
replies.body:
+1 to what rocky said. The map needs more block variation and detail aswell as maybe a wall pattern of for example nether bricks or something to make it more detailed. 
The spawn area is also too square-ish and needs more of a terrain-ish shape as the other islands to fit better.

Otherwise it's cool
